---
title: "1 - Prepare ATO and VMT Data Layers"
format: html
jupyter: python3
---

This first step documents the raw files needed to rebuild the Access to
Opportunity and Vehicle Miles Traveled web-map data. The web app does not run
this work directly; these checks are part of the offline data pipeline.

The expected raw inputs live under `_data/raw/`:

- Statewide TAZ polygons from `_data/raw/statewide TAZ/`
- ATO CSVs from `_data/raw/0 - USTM/`, `_data/raw/1 - WF/`, `_data/raw/2 - CA/`,
  `_data/raw/3 - DX/`, `_data/raw/4 - WB/`, and `_data/raw/5 - IR/`
- VMT `assigned_net.dbf` files from the same model-area folders and scenario
  years

Cache currently has 2023 and 2028 ATO/VMT files in the raw data folder. There
is no 2019 Cache source file in the current data, so the pipeline does not
expect one.

```{python}
import pandas as pd

from _src.process_ato import RAW_ROOT, validate_raw_inputs as validate_ato_inputs
from _src.process_vmt import validate_raw_inputs as validate_vmt_inputs

print(f"Raw data root: {RAW_ROOT}")

raw_inputs = pd.concat(
    [
        validate_ato_inputs().assign(dataset="ATO"),
        validate_vmt_inputs().assign(dataset="VMT"),
    ],
    ignore_index=True,
)
raw_inputs
```

If this step fails, place the missing files in the paths shown by the error and
rerun this document before continuing.
